title: Everyone Is a Creeper
description: A mod that makes every mob explode like a creeper.
body:
## This mod makes every mob explode like a creeper

- Every mob exlodes except the ender dragon
- Spawners are immune to explosions

---

![A pig that is about to explode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51f8fcf0c52f295da1ada3f0b43f95400b3d422b.jpeg)


## Required:
Fabric API
